```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lmtest)
library(sandwich)

run_power_sim_lm <- function(data, n_participants, n_sims = 1000, alpha = 0.05) {
  
  all_participants <- unique(data$participant)
  
  sig_condition_x_dim       <- numeric(n_sims)
  sig_condition_x_dim_x_rel <- numeric(n_sims)
  
  for (i in seq_len(n_sims)) {
    
    sampled_participants <- sample(
      all_participants,
      size = n_participants,
      replace = TRUE
    )
    
    sim_data <- map_dfr(seq_along(sampled_participants), function(j) {
      data %>%
        filter(participant == sampled_participants[j]) %>%
        mutate(participant = paste0("p", j))
    })
    
    fit <- tryCatch(
      lm(
        abs_feature_importance ~ task * feature_relevance * feature_dimension,
        data = sim_data
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    
    if (is.null(fit)) next
    
    coef_table <- coeftest(
      fit,
      vcov = vcovCL(fit, cluster = ~ participant)
    )
    
    rnames <- rownames(coef_table)
    
    row_2way <- grep(
      "task.*feature_dimension|feature_dimension.*task",
      rnames,
      value = TRUE
    )
    
    row_3way <- grep(
      "task.*feature_relevance.*feature_dimension|task.*feature_dimension.*feature_relevance",
      rnames,
      value = TRUE
    )
    
    if (length(row_2way) > 0) {
      sig_condition_x_dim[i] <- any(
        coef_table[row_2way, "Pr(>|t|)"] < alpha
      )
    }
    
    if (length(row_3way) > 0) {
      sig_condition_x_dim_x_rel[i] <- any(
        coef_table[row_3way, "Pr(>|t|)"] < alpha
      )
    }
  }
  
  tibble(
    n_participants = n_participants,
    power_2way     = mean(sig_condition_x_dim),
    power_3way     = mean(sig_condition_x_dim_x_rel)
  )
}
```


```{r}

set.seed(42)

power_results_lm <- map_dfr(candidate_ns, function(n) {
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lmtest)
library(sandwich)

run_power_scaled_lm <- function(
    data,
    n_participants,
    effect_scale = 1.0,
    n_sims = 1000,
    alpha = 0.05
) {
  
  all_participants <- unique(data$participant)
  
  # Fit base model on collected data
  base_model <- lm(
    abs_feature_importance ~ task * feature_relevance * feature_dimension,
    data = data
  )
  
  true_betas <- coef(base_model)
  
  # Identify interaction betas (to scale)
  interaction_idx <- grep(":", names(true_betas))
  
  sig_2way <- numeric(n_sims)
  sig_3way <- numeric(n_sims)
  
  for (i in seq_len(n_sims)) {
    
    # Resample participants with replacement
    sampled_participants <- sample(
      all_participants,
      size = n_participants,
      replace = TRUE
    )
    
    sim_data <- map_dfr(seq_along(sampled_participants), function(j) {
      data %>%
        filter(participant == sampled_participants[j]) %>%
        mutate(participant = paste0("p", j))
    })
    
    # Design matrix
    X <- model.matrix(
      ~ task * feature_relevance * feature_dimension,
      data = sim_data
    )
    
    # Scale interaction effects
    scaled_betas <- true_betas
    scaled_betas[interaction_idx] <-
      scaled_betas[interaction_idx] * effect_scale
    
    # Preserve empirical residual structure
    base_fit_sim <- lm(
      abs_feature_importance ~ task * feature_relevance * feature_dimension,
      data = sim_data
    )
    
    sim_data$y_sim <-
      as.numeric(X %*% scaled_betas) +
      residuals(base_fit_sim)
    
    # Fit simulated model
    fit <- lm(
      y_sim ~ task * feature_relevance * feature_dimension,
      data = sim_data
    )
    
    # Cluster-robust SEs by participant
    coef_table <- coeftest(
      fit,
      vcov = vcovCL(fit, cluster = ~participant)
    )
    
    rnames <- rownames(coef_table)
    
    # task × feature_dimension interactions
    row_2way <- grep(
      "task.*feature_dimension|feature_dimension.*task",
      rnames,
      value = TRUE
    )
    
    # task × feature_relevance × feature_dimension interactions
    row_3way <- grep(
      "task.*feature_relevance.*feature_dimension|task.*feature_dimension.*feature_relevance",
      rnames,
      value = TRUE
    )
    
    if (length(row_2way) > 0) {
      sig_2way[i] <- any(
        coef_table[row_2way, "Pr(>|t|)"] < alpha
      )
    }
    
    if (length(row_3way) > 0) {
      sig_3way[i] <- any(
        coef_table[row_3way, "Pr(>|t|)"] < alpha
      )
    }
  }
  
  tibble(
    n_participants = n_participants,
    effect_scale   = effect_scale,
    power_2way     = mean(sig_2way),
    power_3way     = mean(sig_3way)
  )
}

# Grid of sample sizes and effect scales
candidate_ns  <- seq(400, 1000, by = 200)
effect_scales <- c(1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0)

set.seed(42)

power_grid <- cross_df(list(
  n  = candidate_ns,
  es = effect_scales
)) %>%
  pmap_dfr(function(n, es) {
    
    message("N = ", n, " | scale = ", es)
    
    run_power_scaled_lm(
      data = df_long4,
      n_participants = n,
      effect_scale = es
    )
  })

power_grid
```

```{r}
      power_3way = "Condition × Dimension × Relevance"),
```

```{r}
run_power_scaled_ordinal <- function(
    data,
    n_participants,
    effect_scale = 1.0,
    n_sims = 1000,
    alpha = 0.05
) {
  
  all_participants <- unique(data$participant)
  
  # Fit base ordinal model on real data
  base_model <- clm(
    feature_importance_ord ~ task * feature_relevance * feature_dimension,
    data = data,
    link = "logit"
  )
  
  base_coefs <- coef(base_model)
  
  # Separate thresholds from regression coefficients
  threshold_names <- names(base_coefs)[grepl("\\|", names(base_coefs))]
  beta_names      <- names(base_coefs)[!grepl("\\|", names(base_coefs))]
  
  thresholds <- base_coefs[threshold_names]
  betas      <- base_coefs[beta_names]
  
  # Scale only interaction effects
  interaction_idx <- grep(":", names(betas))
  betas_scaled <- betas
  betas_scaled[interaction_idx] <- betas_scaled[interaction_idx] * effect_scale
  
  sig_2way <- numeric(n_sims)
  sig_3way <- numeric(n_sims)
  
  for (i in seq_len(n_sims)) {
    
    sampled_participants <- sample(
      all_participants,
      size = n_participants,
      replace = TRUE
    )
    
    sim_data <- map_dfr(seq_along(sampled_participants), function(j) {
      data %>%
        filter(participant == sampled_participants[j]) %>%
        mutate(participant = paste0("p", j))
    })
        
    X_full <- model.matrix(
      ~ task * feature_relevance * feature_dimension,
      data = sim_data
    )
    
    X_full <- X_full[, colnames(X_full) != "(Intercept)", drop = FALSE]
    
    missing_cols <- setdiff(names(betas_scaled), colnames(X_full))
    
    if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
      stop(
        "These beta terms are missing from X_full: ",
        paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
      )
    }
    
    X <- X_full[, names(betas_scaled), drop = FALSE]
    
    eta <- as.numeric(X %*% betas_scaled)
    
    # Convert cumulative logits into category probabilities
    cum_probs <- sapply(thresholds, function(thresh) {
      plogis(thresh - eta)
    })
    
    # Add 0 and 1 boundaries
    cum_probs <- cbind(0, cum_probs, 1)
    
    # Category probabilities
    cat_probs <- t(apply(cum_probs, 1, diff))
    
    # Clean up any numerical issues
    cat_probs[cat_probs < 0] <- 0
    cat_probs <- cat_probs / rowSums(cat_probs)
    
    response_levels <- levels(data$feature_importance_ord)
    
    sim_data$y_sim <- apply(cat_probs, 1, function(p) {
      sample(response_levels, size = 1, prob = p)
    })
    
    sim_data$y_sim <- ordered(
      sim_data$y_sim,
      levels = response_levels
    )
    
    fit <- tryCatch(
      clm(
        y_sim ~ task * feature_relevance * feature_dimension,
        data = sim_data,
        link = "logit"
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    
    if (is.null(fit)) next
    
    coef_table <- coef(summary(fit))
    rnames <- rownames(coef_table)
    
    row_2way <- grep(
      "task.*feature_dimension|feature_dimension.*task",
      rnames,
      value = TRUE
    )
    
    row_3way <- grep(
      "task.*feature_relevance.*feature_dimension|task.*feature_dimension.*feature_relevance",
      rnames,
      value = TRUE
    )
    
    if (length(row_2way) > 0) {
      sig_2way[i] <- any(coef_table[row_2way, "Pr(>|z|)"] < alpha)
    }
    
    if (length(row_3way) > 0) {
      sig_3way[i] <- any(coef_table[row_3way, "Pr(>|z|)"] < alpha)
    }
  }
  
  tibble(
    n_participants = n_participants,
    effect_scale = effect_scale,
    power_2way = mean(sig_2way),
    power_3way = mean(sig_3way)
  )
}
```
